clarify the issue: Before the debate starts, the host will clarify the issue so that everyone understands what they are discussing.
辯論開始前，主持人會釐清議題，讓每個人都了解他們在討論什麼。
clarify one's position: Since many voters misunderstood his speech, the mayor held a press conference to clarify his position and clear up the confusion.
由於許多選民誤解了他的演講，市長召開記者會闡明立場並消除困惑。
clarify the rules: Since many new players were confused, the referee took a few minutes to clarify the rules before the game began.
由於許多新球員感到困惑，裁判在比賽開始前花了幾分鐘說明規則。
clash with police: Thousands of angry protesters clashed with police in the streets, and dozens of people were injured.
數千名憤怒的抗議者在街頭與警方衝突，數十人受傷。
opinions clash: When opinions clash during a group project, it is important to listen to each other calmly.
在小組作業中意見衝突時，冷靜地傾聽彼此很重要。
colors clash: Don't wear that red shirt with those orange pants; the colors clash and look terrible together.
別穿那件紅襯衫配那條橘色褲子；顏色不搭，放在一起很難看。
schedules clash: I can't join both the dance club and the school band because their schedules clash on Friday afternoons.
我無法同時參加舞蹈社和學校樂隊，因為它們在星期五下午時間撞期。
clash over policy: The two political parties often clash over policy on energy, especially when it comes to nuclear power.
兩個政黨經常因能源政策起衝突，尤其是談到核能的時候。
classify as top secret: The government decided to classify the documents as top secret, so the public cannot read them.
政府決定將這些文件列為最高機密，所以大眾無法閱讀。
classify the species: Scientists used DNA tests to classify the species of frog they discovered in the mountains last year.
科學家利用DNA檢測，將他們去年在山上發現的青蛙物種分類。
be classified as: Although most people cook tomatoes like vegetables, they are classified as fruits by scientists.
雖然大多數人把番茄當蔬菜來料理，但番茄被科學家歸類為水果。
it suddenly clicked: I didn't understand the math problem at first, but after the teacher drew a picture, it suddenly clicked.
一開始我不懂那道數學題，但老師畫了一張圖之後，我突然明白了。
click with someone: I clicked with my new roommate the moment we met, as if we had known each other for years.
我和新室友一見面就一拍即合，彷彿我們已經認識好多年了。
click on the link: To sign up for the English camp, just click on the link in the email and fill out the form.
要報名英語營，只要點擊電子郵件中的連結並填寫表格即可。
click into place: After I read the last chapter, all the clues in the mystery novel finally clicked into place.
讀完最後一章後，這本推理小說中的所有線索終於豁然開朗。
prices climb: When oil prices climb, the cost of taxis and bus tickets usually goes up as well.
當油價攀升時，計程車和公車的票價通常也會跟著上漲。
climb the career ladder: She worked hard for ten years to climb the career ladder and finally became the company's manager.
她努力工作了十年在職場上往上爬，最後成為公司的經理。
climb to power: The general used the army's support to climb to power after the old king died.
老國王死後，這位將軍利用軍隊的支持攀上權力高峰。
climb back: After falling sharply last month, the company's stock price began to climb back this week.
在上個月大跌之後，這家公司的股價本週開始回升。
cling to hope: Even after days without any news, the families of the missing climbers continue to cling to hope.
即使好幾天沒有任何消息，失蹤登山客的家屬仍緊抓著希望。
cling to tradition: Some small villages still cling to tradition and refuse to change the way they hold weddings.
有些小村莊仍固守傳統，拒絕改變他們舉辦婚禮的方式。
cling to power: The old dictator tried every possible way to cling to power, even though the people wanted him to leave.
這位年老的獨裁者想盡一切辦法戀棧權位，即使人民希望他下台。
cling to one's mother: On the first day of kindergarten, the shy boy would cling to his mother and refuse to go inside.
幼稚園第一天，害羞的男孩黏著媽媽，不肯進教室。
clip someone's wings: My strict parents tried to clip my wings by not allowing me to travel abroad alone.
我嚴格的父母不准我獨自出國旅行，試圖限制我。
clip the coupon: If you clip the coupon from the newspaper, you can get a free drink at the new café.
如果你從報紙上剪下折價券，就可以在新開的咖啡廳得到一杯免費飲料。
clip the hedge: Every spring, my uncle uses a pair of big scissors to clip the hedge in front of our house.
每年春天，我叔叔都會用一把大剪刀修剪我們家前面的樹籬。
a news clip: Our teacher showed us a news clip about the earthquake to help us understand how serious it was.
我們老師播放一段關於地震的新聞片段，幫助我們了解它有多嚴重。
cloud one's judgment: Never let anger cloud your judgment when you have to make an important decision.
當你必須做重要決定時，千萬別讓憤怒影響你的判斷。
cloud the issue: Adding too many unimportant details to your essay will only cloud the issue and confuse the readers.
在作文中加入太多不重要的細節只會模糊議題，讓讀者感到困惑。
a clouded future: Because nobody can tell whether the company will survive, its young employees face a clouded future full of uncertainty.
因為沒人知道公司能否撐下去，年輕員工面臨充滿不確定性、前途不明的未來。
under a cloud: The minister left office under a cloud after reports that he had accepted money from a company.
在傳出他收受某公司金錢的報導後，這位部長在受到懷疑的情況下離職。
